profile.headline: Healthcare Software Engineer | Clinical Data Systems
profile.summary:
Healthcare software engineer with 10+ years building clinical data systems that reach production. I specialize in Epic integrations, SMART on FHIR, and OMOP-based research data platforms.

Currently architecting a healthcare data-as-a-service platform for clinical and translational research at University of Utah / ARUP Labs - spanning data quality pipelines, research feasibility tooling, and OHDSI integration.

PhD in Health Informatics

FHIR · HL7 · OMOP CDM · SNOMED · RxNorm · Epic · Java · Kotlin · Spring Boot · Angular · PostgreSQL · Docker · GraphQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
• Clinical Decision Support Innovation: Led the development of SMART on FHIR applications to improve clinical outcomes. The Bilirubin Management App achieved an 84% improvement in guideline-compliant phototherapy ordering, saving clinicians 374 hours annually, with a 91.8% adoption rate among eligible newborns.
• Healthcare Systems Integration Specialist Architected Epic EHR integration for AI-driven diabetes management system using SMART on FHIR standards and OpenCDS framework, enabling seamless deployment into University of Utah Health's production environment to support clinicians treating multiple patients with real-time patient data access and personalized treatment recommendations
• Technical Leadership & Architecture: Senior technical contributor to ReImagineEHR initiative (https://reimagineehr.utah.edu/), architecting and implementing scalable healthcare software solutions that integrate with Epic EHR using SMART on FHIR standards and modern web technologies
• Enterprise Healthcare Platforms: Built production-scale terminology management and clinical data platforms (ClinBase, EHR Workbench) serving University of Utah Health, enabling healthcare professionals to manage SNOMED CT/RxNorm terminologies, prototype FHIR queries, and streamline clinical research workflows through intuitive full-stack applications
• Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment: Implemented scalable AWS cloud deployments with Docker containerization for HIPAA-compliant healthcare applications, ensuring consistent cross-environment deployment, improved resource utilization, and enhanced security isolation for protected health information processing
• Healthcare User Engagement Analytics: Developed comprehensive user adoption tracking system that processes application logs, integrates with clinical database to identify physician users, and generates automated daily reports on application usage patterns, enabling data-driven product improvement and targeted clinician engagement strategies
positions.insights: Health IT Standards, Spring Framework and +21 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Test System Development: Designed and developed comprehensive testing systems for Honeywell HVAC products including smart thermostats and temperature control devices, encompassing both hardware architecture and software implementation
•	Six Sigma Process Excellence: Achieved Six Sigma Green Belt certification, applying data-driven methodologies and statistical analysis to optimize test development processes, reduce testing cycle times, and improve defect detection rates
•	Software Engineering with Borland C++: Developed robust test automation software using Borland C++ following industry best practices, creating automated test sequences and validation protocols for HVAC control systems
•	Hardware-Software Integration: Architected complete test solutions combining custom hardware design with embedded software programming, ensuring comprehensive validation of product functionality and performance specifications
•	Quality Assurance & Validation: Implemented rigorous testing methodologies to validate product reliability and compliance with industry standards, supporting Honeywell's quality objectives for residential and commercial HVAC systems
